findings_a_vocal.message: A strong early reflection is present approximately 2 ms after the direct sound (-3.1 dB). Close-miked vocals are coloured by reflections this early; move the microphone closer to the singer and farther from the nearest hard surface, or treat that surface, then measure again.
The broadband decay is noticeable (estimated RT60 0.70 s from T30). A vocal that is this live picks up room colour between phrases; add absorption or move to a drier position.
Low frequencies decay more slowly than the mid range (0.83 s vs 0.44 s), which makes vocals sound boxy at this position. Bass trapping or a different position helps.
Mains hum components at multiples of 50 Hz were detected in the quiet part of the recording. Check grounding, cables, dimmers and power supplies before treating the room.

Background noise in the pre-sweep segment is -69.2 dBFS RMS (uncalibrated digital level, not dB SPL). Vocal tracks are often compressed, which brings this noise up; compare it with your chain's noise at the same gain.

The direct sound is only 57 dB above the noise floor in the quiet segment. Sources quieter than this will be recorded with audible noise; lower the noise at the source or increase the playback level within the headroom of the chain.

Potential low-frequency resonances around 110 Hz: these frequencies stand out in the response and ring longer than their surroundings. Measure one or two other positions to see whether they follow the room or the position.

findings_a_voiceover.message: An early reflection is present approximately 2 ms after the direct sound (-3.1 dB). en.daw_instructions:
1. Generate the test signal at your DAW project's sample rate (Step 1).
2. Import it on a new track. Switch time-stretching off for that clip (Warp, Flex, Follow Tempo, elastic audio) and bypass plug-ins on its track and on the master bus, including room-correction plug-ins.
3. Route that track to the one loudspeaker you want to test.
4. Arm a second track with the measurement microphone (input monitoring off) and record while the test signal plays.
5. Export the recorded track as WAV, AIFF, CAF or FLAC at the project sample rate, without normalising.
   Do not trim it - ReverbScope finds the sweep automatically.
Start with a low monitor level; the sweep should be clearly audible but not loud.
The user guide has step-by-step notes for Pro Tools, Logic Pro, Cubase, Studio One, Ableton Live, REAPER, FL Studio and Bitwig Studio.
daw_sample_rate_settings: Session Setup shows the session rate; generate the sweep at that rate rather than enabling Apply SRC in File ▸ Import ▸ Audio
File ▸ Project Settings ▸ Audio ▸ Sample Rate
no sample-rate setting: generate the sweep at 44.1 kHz
Session ▸ Session Setup (Song ▸ Song Setup in Studio One before v8)
Settings (Options ▸ Settings on Windows, Live ▸ Settings on macOS) ▸ Audio ▸ In/Out Sample Rate
File ▸ Project Settings ▸ tick Project sample rate, and in Preferences ▸ Audio ▸ Device tick Request sample rate with the same rate
the Sample Rate setting in the Control Panel
Project Sample Rate in the Quality section of Audio Setup ▸ Audio Settings
daw_stretch_settings: Pro Tools
the track's Elastic Audio selector reads None – Disable Elastic Audio; import with File ▸ Import rather than by dragging from the desktop
Logic Pro
Region inspector: untick Flex and set Smart Tempo to Off (Logic 12.2 and earlier: Flex & Follow = Off); File ▸ Project Settings ▸ Smart Tempo ▸ Set Imported Files To = Flex Off
GarageBand
audio editor: untick Follow Tempo and Pitch, leave Enable Flex off
Cubase / Nuendo
Musical Mode off for the sweep clip (Sample Editor or Pool)
Fender Studio Pro
Track Inspector: Tempo mode = Don't Follow; Event Inspector: Speedup 1, Transpose and Tune 0
Ableton Live
Clip View: Warp off; Settings ▸ Record, Warp & Launch: Auto-Warp Long Samples off
REAPER
Item Properties (F2): Playback rate 1.0 and no stretch markers; do not change the tempo after importing
FL Studio
channel settings: Time knob at (none); General settings ▸ Read sample tempo information off
Bitwig Studio
Inspector: Stretch ▸ Mode = Raw (there is no Off)
Digital Performer
untick Stretch in the Track Settings menu of the sweep track; soundbite Time Compress/Expand = Don't Time Scale

findings_a_vocal.message: 直达声后约 2 ms 有一条强早期反射（-3.1 dB）。近距离人声会被这样早的反射染色；把话筒靠近歌手并远离最近的硬表面，或处理该表面，然后重测。

zh.daw_instructions:
1. 按 DAW 工程的采样率生成测试信号（步骤 1）。
2. 把它导入新轨道。关闭该片段的时间伸缩（Warp、Flex、Follow Tempo、Elastic Audio），并旁通该轨道和主输出总线上的插件，包括房间校正插件。
3. 将该轨道只路由到要测的那一只扬声器。
4. 用测量话筒武装第二条轨道（关闭输入监听），在测试信号播放时录音。
5. 按工程采样率把录音轨导出为 WAV、AIFF、CAF 或 FLAC，不要做标准化。
   不要裁切——ReverbScope 会自动找到扫频。
先调低监听音量；扫频应清楚可闻，但不要很大声。
用户指南里有 Pro Tools、Logic Pro、Cubase、Studio One、Ableton Live、REAPER、FL Studio 和 Bitwig Studio 的分步说明。
daw_sample_rate_settings: Session Setup 中可见工程采样率；按该采样率生成扫频，而不要在 File ▸ Import ▸ Audio 中勾选 Apply SRC
File ▸ Project Settings ▸ Audio ▸ Sample Rate
没有采样率设置：按 44.1 kHz 生成扫频
Session ▸ Session Setup（v8 之前的 Studio One 为 Song ▸ Song Setup）
Settings（Windows 上为 Options ▸ Settings，macOS 上为 Live ▸ Settings）▸ Audio ▸ In/Out Sample Rate
File ▸ Project Settings ▸ 勾选 Project sample rate，并在 Preferences ▸ Audio ▸ Device 中勾选 Request sample rate，设为同一采样率
Control Panel 中的 Sample Rate 设置
Audio Setup ▸ Audio Settings 的 Quality 部分中的 Project Sample Rate
daw_stretch_settings: Pro Tools
轨道的 Elastic Audio 选择器显示 None – Disable Elastic Audio；用 File ▸ Import 导入，不要从桌面拖入
Logic Pro
Region inspector：取消勾选 Flex，并把 Smart Tempo 设为 Off（Logic 12.2 及更早：Flex & Follow = Off）；File ▸ Project Settings ▸ Smart Tempo ▸ Set Imported Files To = Flex Off
GarageBand
音频编辑器：取消勾选 Follow Tempo and Pitch，保持 Enable Flex 关闭
Cubase / Nuendo
扫频片段关闭 Musical Mode（在 Sample Editor 或 Pool 中）
Fender Studio Pro
Track Inspector：Tempo 模式 = Don't Follow；Event Inspector：Speedup 为 1，Transpose 和 Tune 为 0
Ableton Live
Clip View：关闭 Warp；Settings ▸ Record, Warp & Launch：关闭 Auto-Warp Long Samples
REAPER
Item Properties（F2）：Playback rate 为 1.0，没有 stretch marker；导入后不要再改速度
FL Studio
通道设置：Time 旋钮置于 (none)；关闭 General settings ▸ Read sample tempo information
Bitwig Studio
Inspector：Stretch ▸ Mode = Raw（没有 Off 选项）
Digital Performer
在扫频轨道的 Track Settings 菜单中取消勾选 Stretch；soundbite 的 Time Compress/Expand = Don't Time Scale
